subject: Aurora Cloud - subprocessor inventory & export evidence request

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@aurora-cloud.com>

Cc: dan.ortiz@aurora-cloud.com
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subprocessor inventory + evidence for DPA review

Hi Karthik,

We're preparing the DPA addendum for our upcoming procurement review and need a current list of Redwood's subprocessors that will process Aurora customer telemetry or logs. Specifically we need:  
- a CSV with vendor name, role (processing/hosting/telemetry), countries where they operate, and whether they are onshore fallback-capable;  
- a short export path summary that shows any cross-border egress (S3/bucket names or region pairs are fine); and
- one or two example evidence items (eg. a signed vendor attestation or a manifest) for the telemetry pipeline.

Can you share that by EOD Tuesday 11 May? Procurement needs the package for a vendor-risk call on Wednesday. If you have a contact on your legal team to route the DPA addendum redlines to, please include them.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation of timeline.

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of Security Operations
Aurora Cloud

--

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Aurora subproc request — telemetry evidence needed

Thanks Marissa — reviewed the checklist and the prelim CSV. A few legal points we should address before broad handoff:  

- ObsStream attestation: redactions are fine for vendor-specific IP, but we need an explicit line that confirms they do not retain Aurora-identifying PII beyond required retention windows.
- Export manifest: we can provide file-level manifest showing bucket/region topology, but not object-level names for live customer traces.
- KMS jurisdiction: provide high-level key residency and KMS provider name — do not include HSM serials or internal KMS ACLs.
- DPA addendum: I've drafted a short addendum (attached) that includes onshore fallback commitments for critical telemetry processing. Please review and flag any operational blockers.

If Aurora needs an unredacted file trace for the procurement risk call, propose they sign an evidence NDA and we will share via an SFTP escrow link. I've attached the draft addendum (signed-dpa-addendum-draft.docx) and left comment slots.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
